observations.body: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The psalm repeatedly returns to rebellion and grief in the wilderness.
observations.label: Repeated grief and mercy

observations.body: The psalm makes the wilderness a cycle of rebellion, restraint, forgiveness, and failed memory.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Psalms 78:38–42 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Mercy interrupts destruction without ending the people’s repeated resistance.
payload.title: Rebellion retold
